era: The redesigned AccuWeather.com that launched before June 2019 (Wayback 2019-06-30 capture and the 2019-12 Arquivo forecast page share it): dark header with the orange AccuWeather logo and 'Search location, zip...', Weather / Radar & Maps / News / Video / Severe Weather / More menu, Personalized Forecasts, and forecast cards Current Weather, Today, Tonight, Tomorrow, radar, Hourly, Daily, Month, MinuteCast. It is the design every 2019 visitor saw from mid-2019 on, so the current layout is kept and only later cards are removed.
